authorizationAcceptanceScenarios: Customer A cannot access Customer B booking, receipt or credentials; changing IDs in direct API calls does not bypass verified ownership.
Venue A staff cannot read or mutate Venue B resources without a matching grant.
Finance permission at Venue A cannot combine with Operations scope at Venue B for a Venue B payment.
Correct permission and resource scope within one applicable grant permit the intended operation when all mandatory restrictions and business guards pass.
Missing permissions, mandatory attributes or mandatory policy information deny; explicitly approved public browsing can remain anonymous.
When the proposed self-approval prohibition is approved, it applies globally across all roles and alternative grants; verify independent-review rules chosen by the owner.
Refund approval obeys approved account/venue/currency limits; unset required limit is not unlimited; approval is distinct from execution.
Ordinary customer/account management does not grant identity-evidence access; dedicated permission, authorized case and legitimate server-validated review purpose required; sensitive reads audited.
Unauthorized package publication, multi-venue scope expansion and receiving-bank-account changes rejected; package edit does not grant publish.
List/search/count/aggregate/report/export/download and live subscription/reconnect paths scope data server-side, without protected existence/count leakage.
Removed roles, suspension, venue reassignment and policy changes invalidate stale authority within the explicitly selected revocation policy; valid login alone is insufficient.
Concurrent permission/policy/resource changes cannot bypass sensitive mutation authorization and business-state checks.
Service/device/integration identities remain within their assigned actions and resource scope; authenticated callbacks are distinct from customer sessions.
Authorized actors cannot verify nonexistent funds, double allocate, exceed refundable balance, violate reservation/capacity/hours or rewrite purchased terms.
Authorization failure, session expiry or payment state cannot obstruct independent physical emergency exit; simulator evidence is insufficient physical proof.
Ordinary staff cannot self-escalate roles/permissions; dedicated assignment controls enforce permitted target/scope and audit attempts without generic ADMIN bypass.

Accepted durable work is distinguished from a new privileged action; revalidate under the selected service/current-safety policy without indefinitely inheriting revoked actor grants or silently losing accepted financial obligations.

Permission-aware UI handles denial, expired session, changed permissions and policy unavailability; clears/refetches protected content, ends revoked streams and reports success only after backend confirmation.
